comment.body:
main-pr507-owner-contract-adopted-20260918
The owner decision of 2026-09-18T01:47:51Z supersedes MAIN's earlier policy
hold, including comment5716586574 and the negative status concerning the
advertisement-to-commit window. That residual window is now explicitly
authorized under the following contract:

1. Claim every member PR on the shared atomic claim list before manifest
   verification, as party `main`, kind `train`. Hold every claim until
   transport ends.
2. Retain the leased atomic push of verified content.
3. Immediately after a successful push, re-read every member ref. Record
   any difference from its verified SHA as a contract violation. The moved
   member's later commits are absent from main, our tooling must not mark
   it merged, and the report must attribute the movement according to the
   claim list, preserving that evidence.
4. Document this contract and its residual window explicitly. A server-side
   predicate is not required by this authorized contract.

Prerequisite #579 merged at 01:44:23Z as
`3094094f53d120acd9b67698125344dbab20fa1a`; `local/bin/claim.sh` is on main.
The existing Opus fixer claim is respected. This is an administrative
adoption of the owner's contract, not a review of the forthcoming changes.
Implementation, regression tests, green exact-head CI, and a fresh
independent review remain required. MAIN will check the actual marked
review, verdict, findings and head before publishing summary success.
Normal update, strict section-13 carry where eligible, and daemon merge
follow. Existing review history and costs remain recorded.

current_status.description: Owner contract authorized; implementation and independent review pending
